title: Small Habits, Big Changes
author: Bookly (namuna dars)
tagline: Har kuni takrorlangan kichik qadamlar qanday qilib katta natija beradi.
intro: Bu qisqa darsda odatlar qanday shakllanishini va ularni kundalik hayotda qanday qilib oson boshlashni bilib olasiz. Inglizcha audioni tinglang, o‘zbekcha tarjima esa ma’noni tushunishga yordam beradi.
learnPoints: Nega kichik harakatlar vaqt o‘tib katta natija beradi
Yangi odatni qanday qilib juda oson boshlash mumkin
Bir kun o‘tkazib yuborsangiz nima qilish kerak
attribution: Bookly jamoasi tomonidan yozilgan original namuna dars. Muayyan kitobning qisqacha mazmuni emas.

sentences.en: Small habits lead to big changes.
sentences.uz: Kichik odatlar katta o‘zgarishlarga olib keladi.

sentences.en: A habit is something you do so often that you hardly think about it.
sentences.uz: Odat — shunchalik ko‘p takrorlaydigan ishingizki, u haqida deyarli o‘ylamaysiz.

sentences.en: Brushing your teeth, checking your phone and the way you start your homework are all habits.
sentences.uz: Tish yuvish, telefonni tekshirish va uy vazifasini qanday boshlashingiz — bularning barchasi odatlar.

sentences.en: One small action does not look important on a single day.
sentences.uz: Bitta kichik harakat bir kunning o‘zida muhim bo‘lib ko‘rinmaydi.

sentences.en: But when you repeat it every day, the results add up.
sentences.uz: Ammo uni har kuni takrorlasangiz, natijalar yig‘ilib boradi.

sentences.en: Reading ten pages a day becomes more than fifteen books in a year.
sentences.uz: Kuniga o‘n bet o‘qish bir yilda o‘n beshtadan ortiq kitobga aylanadi.

sentences.en: Learning five new English words a day becomes more than eighteen hundred words a year.
sentences.uz: Kuniga beshta yangi inglizcha so‘z o‘rganish bir yilda bir ming sakkiz yuzdan ortiq so‘zga aylanadi.

sentences.en: Progress is often invisible at first, and that is why many people give up too early.
sentences.uz: Boshida o‘sish ko‘pincha ko‘rinmaydi, shuning uchun ko‘p odamlar juda erta taslim bo‘ladi.

sentences.en: Most people try to change too much at once.
sentences.uz: Ko‘pchilik bir vaqtning o‘zida juda ko‘p narsani o‘zgartirishga urinadi.

sentences.en: They promise to study for three hours every evening, and after a week they stop.
sentences.uz: Ular har kuni kechqurun uch soat o‘qishga va’da berishadi, bir haftadan keyin esa to‘xtab qolishadi.

sentences.en: A better plan is to make the new habit so easy that you cannot say no.
sentences.uz: Yaxshiroq reja — yangi odatni shunchalik osonlashtiringki, unga «yo‘q» deya olmang.

sentences.en: Instead of saying “I will study for three hours”, say “I will open my notebook and solve one problem”.
sentences.uz: «Uch soat o‘qiyman» deyish o‘rniga, «Daftarimni ochib, bitta masala yechaman» deng.

sentences.en: Starting is the hardest part, and once you start, it is easier to continue.
sentences.uz: Eng qiyini — boshlash; boshlaganingizdan keyin davom ettirish osonroq bo‘ladi.

sentences.en: First build the habit of showing up, and then slowly increase how much you do.
sentences.uz: Avval har kuni ishga kirishish odatini shakllantiring, keyin esa uning hajmini asta-sekin oshiring.

sentences.en: Your environment shapes your behaviour more than your motivation does.
sentences.uz: Muhitingiz xatti-harakatlaringizga motivatsiyadan ko‘ra kuchliroq ta’sir qiladi.

sentences.en: If your phone is next to you while you study, you will probably check it.
sentences.uz: Agar o‘qiyotganingizda telefoningiz yoningizda tursa, ehtimol, uni tekshirib qo‘yasiz.

sentences.en: If your English book is on your desk, you are more likely to open it.
sentences.uz: Agar ingliz tili kitobingiz stolingizda tursa, uni ochish ehtimoli ortadi.

sentences.en: So put good habits where you can see them and bad habits where you cannot.
sentences.uz: Shuning uchun yaxshi odatlarni ko‘z oldingizga, yomon odatlarni esa ko‘zdan uzoqroqqa qo‘ying.

sentences.en: You can also connect a new habit to something you already do.
sentences.uz: Yangi odatni allaqachon qilib yurgan ishingizga bog‘lashingiz ham mumkin.

sentences.en: For example: after I have breakfast, I will listen to one English lesson.
sentences.uz: Masalan: nonushta qilganimdan keyin bitta inglizcha dars tinglayman.

heading.en: Think about who you are becoming

sentences.en: Goals show where you want to go, but habits decide where you actually arrive.
sentences.uz: Maqsadlar qayerga bormoqchi ekaningizni ko‘rsatadi, ammo aslida qayerga yetib borishingizni odatlar hal qiladi.

sentences.en: A useful question is not only “What do I want to achieve?” but also “What kind of person do I want to be?”
sentences.uz: Foydali savol faqat «Nimaga erishmoqchiman?» emas, balki «Qanday inson bo‘lishni xohlayman?» hamdir.

sentences.en: If you see yourself as a reader, reading a few pages feels natural.
sentences.uz: Agar o‘zingizni kitobxon deb bilsangiz, bir necha bet o‘qish tabiiy tuyuladi.

sentences.en: Every small action is proof to yourself that you can change.
sentences.uz: Har bir kichik harakat o‘zgara olishingizni o‘zingizga isbotlaydi.

sentences.en: Nobody is perfect, and some days you will miss your habit.
sentences.uz: Hech kim mukammal emas, ba’zi kunlari odatingizni o‘tkazib yuborasiz.

sentences.en: One missed day is a small break; a long pause is what really breaks a habit.
sentences.uz: Bir kun o‘tkazib yuborish — kichik tanaffus; odatni haqiqatan buzadigan narsa esa uzoq to‘xtab qolishdir.

sentences.en: On difficult days, do a smaller version instead of doing nothing.
sentences.uz: Qiyin kunlarda hech narsa qilmaslik o‘rniga, odatning kichikroq ko‘rinishini bajaring.

sentences.en: Read one page, write one sentence or listen for two minutes.
sentences.uz: Bir bet o‘qing, bitta gap yozing yoki ikki daqiqa tinglang.

sentences.en: Keep a simple record, like a tick in a calendar, so you can see your progress.
sentences.uz: Oddiy qayd yuriting — masalan, taqvimga belgi qo‘ying — shunda o‘sishingizni ko‘rib turasiz.

sentences.en: Small steps, repeated with patience, will take you further than you expect.
sentences.uz: Sabr bilan takrorlangan kichik qadamlar sizni kutganingizdan ham uzoqroqqa olib boradi.

vocab.definition: something you do regularly, often without thinking
vocab.example: Reading before bed is a good habit.
vocab.exampleUz: Uxlashdan oldin kitob o‘qish — yaxshi odat.

vocab.definition: to do or say something again
vocab.example: Repeat the new word three times.
I can see my progress in English.
Don't give up after one bad day.
vocab.exampleUz: Bitta yomon kundan keyin taslim bo‘lmang.

vocab.definition: the place and things around you
vocab.example: A quiet environment helps me study.
vocab.exampleUz: Tinch muhit menga o‘qishda yordam beradi.

vocab.definition: the feeling of wanting to do something
vocab.example: Motivation comes and goes, but habits stay.
Small changes in behaviour can bring big results.
vocab.exampleUz: Xatti-harakatdagi kichik o‘zgarishlar katta natija berishi mumkin.

questions.prompt: According to the summary, why do many people give up too early?
questions.promptUz: Matnga ko‘ra, nega ko‘p odamlar juda erta taslim bo‘ladi?
options: Because progress is often invisible at first
Because good habits are always expensive
Because they read too many books
optionsUz: Chunki ular juda ko‘p kitob o‘qiydi
questions.explanationUz: Birinchi bo‘limda aytilganidek, natija boshida sezilmaydi — shu sabab ko‘pchilik erta to‘xtaydi.

questions.prompt: What is a better way to start a new study habit?
questions.promptUz: Yangi o‘qish odatini boshlashning yaxshiroq yo‘li qaysi?
options: Study for three hours every evening
Make the habit so easy that you cannot say no
Wait until you feel very motivated
optionsUz: Har kuni kechqurun uch soat o‘qish
Odatni shunchalik osonlashtirish-ki, unga «yo‘q» deya olmaysiz
Juda katta ishtiyoq paydo bo‘lishini kutish
questions.explanationUz: Ikkinchi bo‘lim: juda kichik boshlang — masalan, daftarni ochib bitta masala yeching.

questions.prompt: What should you do on a difficult day?
options: Do a smaller version of the habit
questions.explanationUz: Oxirgi bo‘limda aytilganidek: bir bet o‘qing yoki ikki daqiqa tinglang — hech narsa qilmagandan yaxshiroq.

takeaway.en: Choose one tiny habit for tomorrow and connect it to something you already do.
takeaway.uz: Ertangi kun uchun bitta juda kichik odat tanlang va uni allaqachon qilib yurgan ishingizga bog‘lang.
